user.title: ZTE access points
user.description: Addresses of the router and any mesh units, e.g. `http://192.168.1.1`. Logins are read from the `ZTE_USERNAME` and `ZTE_PASSWORD` environment variables of the Home Assistant container. Units with their own login: `ZTE_CREDENTIALS`, a JSON object like `{"192.168.1.2": {"username": "...", "password": "..."}}`.

reconfigure.title: ZTE access points
reconfigure.description: Addresses of the router and any mesh units. Tracked devices stay as they are.

devices.title: Devices to track
devices.description: Each selected device is home while it is connected to the Wi-Fi of any of the access points.

error.no_urls: Enter at least one access point address.
error.invalid_url: Addresses must look like `http://192.168.1.1` (http or https, no login in the address).
error.missing_env: `ZTE_USERNAME` and `ZTE_PASSWORD` are not set in the Home Assistant container (and `ZTE_CREDENTIALS` has no entry for one of the access points).
error.invalid_auth: An access point rejected the login (or is locked after failed logins).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an access point or read its Wi-Fi client list.
error.invalid_env: `ZTE_CREDENTIALS` in the Home Assistant container must look like `{"host": {"username": "...", "password": "..."}}`.
